did_you_know.text: Naomi seeks to find Ruth a “place of rest”—that is, a stable and secure future. This shows that she cares not only about Ruth’s livelihood but also about her long-term security.
Boaz is described as winnowing barley at the threshing floor at night. The text portrays him as an active man who personally takes care of the grain and his work.
Naomi tells Ruth to wash, anoint herself, and put on her best clothes before going down to the threshing floor. These are preparations for a significant meeting with Boaz.
Ruth is told to lie down at Boaz’s feet and wait for his instructions. These verses do not describe a sexual encounter, but rather a respectful request for protection and redemption.
When Boaz discovers Ruth at his feet, he is startled and asks who she is. His reaction emphasizes that she arrived secretly in the middle of the night.
Ruth asks Boaz, “Spread your wings over your servant.” By saying this, she asks for his protection and reminds him that he is a redeemer—someone who may act on behalf of her family.
Boaz praises Ruth and says that her latest kindness is greater than the first. He points out that she did not pursue young men, whether rich or poor, but acted with loyalty and responsibility.

Boaz explains that although he is a redeemer, there is another redeemer who is closer. Therefore, he does not bypass the proper order of priority but promises to first determine whether the closer redeemer will exercise his right.
Boaz swears by the Lord that if the closer redeemer will not redeem Ruth, he himself will redeem her. However, he asks her to stay until morning in order to preserve order and honor.

Boaz gives Ruth six measures of barley in her garment and sends her back to Naomi. The text does not specify the exact weight of each measure, so it is impossible to determine with certainty how much grain she carried.
Naomi is confident that Boaz will not rest until he settles the matter, and she believes it will be resolved that very day. Her confidence is based on Boaz’s determination to act.
